scope: Approve deletion of only the two hash-pinned obsolete section database snapshots listed above, plus the exact regenerable .DS_Store and __pycache__/*.pyc entries in deletion_plan.json. This review does not approve changes to any source, training, verified/adjudicated, registry, production, or Jeju-specific database files.

database_review.comparison_method: Read-only SQLite mode=ro with query_only=ON. Distinct source-value tuples were compared using EXCEPT on meet_code, race_date, race_number, distance_m, kra_horse_id, horse_number, point_code, elapsed_time_ms, source_name, and source_field. Persistent support tables were also compared.

section_points.sqlite3.reason: The stronger source key comparison found 756700 distinct source-value tuples absent from the retained adjudicated DB; do not delete the base snapshot based on the earlier weaker-key report.

section_points_verified.sqlite3.reason: Retained, independently validated source database and direct input to the adjudication build.

section_points_adjudicated.sqlite3.reason: Retained latest research database, used by current reports and analyses.

database_review.database_integrity: All five section databases passed SQLite PRAGMA quick_check during the review.

dependencies_and_rebuild.documented_rebuild: build_section_point_db.py build-verified reads the operational database and retained Thoroughbred unified DuckDB to recreate section_points_verified.sqlite3; adjudicate_section_points.py reads verified plus retained raw KRA evidence and current KRA pages to create section_points_adjudicated.sqlite3. Neither documented command depends on the two approved deletion candidates.
dependencies_and_rebuild.legacy_commands: build_section_point_db.py extend and repair still use the hard-coded section_points_ext.sqlite3 path. The handoff explicitly marks the old base/ext/repair pipeline as intermediate and says not to use it. Update the handoff with a dated retirement note and retain the deletion plan/receipt for provenance; do not describe the deleted snapshots as still preserved.
dependencies_and_rebuild.shared_data_boundary: The approved paths are exact files within the shared section-point research directory. Keep the source DBs, section_points.sqlite3 base snapshot, section_points_verified.sqlite3, section_points_adjudicated.sqlite3, data/horse_racing.sqlite3, thoroughbred_unified.duckdb, Jeju data, and all registry artifacts. No wildcard deletion of the shared directory is approved.

integrity_and_runtime_checks.candidate_hashes: The candidate hashes and lengths match section_databases_before.json and deletion_plan.json.
integrity_and_runtime_checks.open_handles: lsof returned exit status 1 with empty stdout/stderr for the five section database paths at review time. cleanup.py must repeat its lsof gate immediately before unlinking.
integrity_and_runtime_checks.production_registry: The Thoroughbred and Jeju profiles remain registry-selected and separately hash-verified; the deletion whitelist excludes config/prediction_model_registry.json and every registered artifact.
integrity_and_runtime_checks.cli_review: Reviewed the registry-backed Thoroughbred CLI for complete-card, model-cutoff, venue, historical-label, fresh-output-path, and output-root safeguards. The registry is hash-checked before model loading and before output publication. The recorded replay verification covers 294 runners and 540 B/C rows with exact probability and raw-score equality; six CLI tests are recorded passing. The CLI does not write to the database, publish, or promote models.
integrity_and_runtime_checks.execution: This review records approval only; it does not execute file deletion.

limitations: EXCEPT compares distinct projected tuples. Local database row IDs and derived time_kind, classification, representation, and view definitions are intentionally not compared; those old labels are not retained by raw-value coverage and the snapshots are explicitly forbidden for use.

Deleting ext/repaired retires those exact historical intermediate database bytes. Their old extend/repair workflow is not a supported rebuild path; the documented verified/adjudicated rebuild remains available from the retained sources.
The weaker-key comparison is retained as section_comparison_weaker_not_for_delete.json for audit history and must not be used to justify deletion.
